newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire development seen netting HK$4 bln.
newsitem.headline: Swire development seen netting HK$4 bln.

text.p: Swire Pacific Ltd said it will start pre-sale of 48 residential units in its Island Place property development in Hong Kong's North Point district at an average price of HK$6,282 per sq ft next week.

Analysts expected the residential units at Island Place, a residential and commercial development jointly owned by Swire and China Motor Bus Co Ltd, to net a total of HK$4.0 billion if all the 784 units were sold at the average price.
The development on the former China Motor Bus depot site in North Point is 60 percent owned by Swire and 40 percent by China Motor Bus.
Swire said registration for the units will take place from September 10 to 13 and flat selection will be on September 16.
The development included three residential blocks of 784 units, 288 carpark spaces, 15,000 sq ft rential poduim and a 25 storey 472,000 sq ft office tower.
The residential blocks and shopping space would be completed later this year while constructions of the office tower was expected to be finished in 1997.
